paragraphs.text: EPUB reader plugin for DeepSeek Harness: shelf, excerpts, a book list of every mentioned title, and
an AI chapter guide with source-linked cards.

BookWeave · 书脉
Read EPUBs inside DSH, discover every book they cite, and let an AI guide you through
Read EPUBs inside DSH, discover every book they cite, and let an AI guide you through the chapters.
English | 中文
BookWeave is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **Web client plugin**. It turns the sidebar into an EPUB readi
ng workspace: a shelf, a distraction-free reader, excerpts, a network of every book mentioned in the
text, and an AI-assisted **book guide** that summarises a chapter and turns its claims and evidence
into clickable cards backed by the original paragraphs.
> Everything is local-first: EPUBs, excerpts, reading progress and AI results live in your browser's
IndexedDB. The only network call is the optional "Analyze chapter" request to your configured model
. The only network call is the optional "Analyze chapter" request to your configured model provider.
## Features
| **Shelf & folder import** | Left category sidebar (create / rename / delete), per-book category pi
cker on every cover, and one-click **Import folder**: recursively imports every EPUB under the chose
n folder (duplicates skipped) into the active category. Both normal `.epub` files and **extracted `.

epub` folders** (with `META-INF/container.xml`) are supported. |
| **Shelf** | Import `.epub` by cli
ck or drag & drop; 2:3 portrait covers extracted from the EPUB; book title, author and reading perce

ntage only. |
| **Reader** | Serif prose, adjustable font size, TOC built from the book's NCX/nav bo
undaries (Calibre-style split files merge into their chapter; parts are marked), chapter navigation,
remembered progress. No fixed header — the reading area and the right rail both start at the top of

the window. |
| **Book list** | Extracts every book the current book mentions: 《》 titles, English “
quoted title” cues and a curated lexicon, with noise filters (self-references, TOC, chapter headings

, periodicals). Each entry links back to the paragraph where it appears. |
| **Excerpts & notes** |
Select text → red underline + excerpt card with an optional note. Every entry (excerpt or note) rend
ers as the same action card — badge, chapter/time, text, and always-visible Locate / Note (excerpts)
/ Edit (notes) / Delete. Adding a thought automatically lists its source passage here too (older no
tes fall back to the current paragraph text). Locate is a real button; list text uses the system fon

t (handwriting stays in the margin). |
| **Margin notes** | The reading column is narrower; the free
d right margin shows your thoughts in a **handwriting font**, anchored to the paragraph (or selectio
n) they belong to. Pick one of six ink colors per note; the referenced text gets a **dashed underlin
e in the same color** while notes are shown. Add from the selection toolbar or the “+” in the margin
. The floating toolbar toggles notes with an animated collapse — when hidden, a colored vertical bar

marks every annotated paragraph and expands them again on click. |
[该节后续省略]

`llm` service (any provider that DSH can already call); without it, reading, excerpts, book lists a
nd the heuristic guide still work.

## AI analysis & privacy

- **Opt-in only.** Opening a book, switching chapters or tabs never calls a model.
- **Small prompts
.** One chapter's compressed excerpt (≤6,000 chars client-side, 8,000 host-side), concise JSON outpu

t (≤700 tokens), lowest reasoning effort the model advertises, no retries.
- **Cached.** Results are
stored per book + chapter + content fingerprint in IndexedDB. Reopening a chapter shows “Cached” an

d costs nothing; “Analyze again” is the only way to spend tokens twice.
- **No telemetry.** The plug
in makes exactly one kind of network request: `POST /api/dsh-bookweave/analyze` to its own DSH host,

which forwards the prompt to your configured model provider.
- **Model override.** Set `DSH_BOOKWEA
VE_MODEL=provider/model` before launching DSH to pin a cheaper model for analysis.
## Data storage

IndexedDB database `dsh-bookweave` (version 3): `books`, `index`, `excerpts`, `insights`.
Deleting a
book removes its text, book list, excerpts and AI results. Nothing leaves the machine except the op
ext, book list, excerpts and AI results. Nothing leaves the machine except the opt-in model request.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The suites run in plain Node (≥20) without a browser, React or npm dependencies. They load `client/c
lient.js` through the same `window.__ModuleLoader__` seam the DSH Web client uses, and exercise the
`plugin.core` exports plus a fake host-side LLM for the AI route. See `test/README.md`.

## Known limitations
- EPUB parsing is a tolerant pure-JS implementation; malformed EPUBs fall back to a lighter archive

discovery path, but DRM-protected files are not supported.
- Mention extraction is heuristic: it err
s on the side of recall and can include the current book or chapter titles; the book-list UI marks t

hem and the export keeps them out of the “found books” count.
- The AI guide is per chapter and capp

ed for cost; it is not a full-book analysis.
- The built-in browser cannot inject text into a cross-

origin page; it opens a search URL instead.
- AI results depend on the configured model; a weak mode
l may produce a poor summary. Cached results are never silently replaced.
